name: How long does a kitchen renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical kitchen renovation project can take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks from demolition to completion, depending on its complexity and scale. This timeframe includes ordering materials, demolition, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, cabinet installation, countertop fabrication and installation, flooring, backsplash, and appliance installation. Custom cabinetry or unique material selections can extend the timeline due to longer lead times. We work to establish a realistic timeline upfront and keep you informed of progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen renovation usually takes 6 to 12 weeks, depending on project complexity, from demolition through all installations. Custom elements can extend this duration.
